history.title: Dyno Logs
history.empty: No six-axis snapshots yet. Open the Dyno tab, run an assessment, and save your first snapshot.
history.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this snapshot? This action cannot be undone.

IGN-01.name: First Ignition
IGN-01.desc: Log your first attendance day and start the local dyno record.

ARC-01.name: First Archive
ARC-01.desc: Store the first six-axis snapshot in the local dyno log.

RHY-03.name: Weekly Rhythm
RHY-03.desc: Reach 3 attendance days in the current Mon–Sun week.

CRS-04.name: Cruise Lock
CRS-04.desc: Hit at least 3 sessions in 4 consecutive Mon–Sun weeks. If this week is not yet qualified, the streak starts from last week.

HIST-10.name: Data Foundation
HIST-10.desc: Store 10 six-axis snapshots in the local dyno log.

PR-01.name: First Break
PR-01.desc: Reach personal-record intensity on any attendance day.

SPEC-6.name: Six-Axis Live
SPEC-6.desc: All six assessment scores are greater than 0 (arm size excluded).

ARM-01.name: Girth Logged
ARM-01.desc: Store a valid arm-size score locally. Optional spec — not part of the six-axis radar.

5K-01.name: 5K Finish
5K-01.desc: Store a valid 5 km finish time locally. Optional specialty — does not replace the cardio radar axis.

SPR-01.name: 100 m Start
SPR-01.desc: Store a valid 100 m sprint time locally. Optional specialty — does not fill the explosive radar axis.
